## `savant_energy.create_scene`

Create a Savant Energy scene. Stores a named set of relay states.

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Yes | str | Human-readable scene name | `Evening Lights` |
| `relay_states` | Yes | dict | Mapping of device ids to boolean states (true = on). | `{"breaker_1": true, "breaker_2": false}` |

## `savant_energy.update_scene`

Update an existing Savant Energy scene by id.

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scene_id` | Yes | str | ID of the scene to update | — |
| `name` | No | str | Optional new name for the scene | — |
| `relay_states` | No | dict | Optional new mapping of relay states to store | — |

## `savant_energy.save_scenes`

Overwrite the saved scenes storage with a provided list.

| Field | Required | Type | Description | Example |
